links.outcome: Clinician-reported reasons for editing ambient AI drafts (transcription, attribution, omission errors)
links.effect: Clinicians edited drafts because of transcription errors, speaker attribution mistakes, overconfident unsupported statements, missing key clinical details, and lack of patient context. No numeric rates reported.
links.quote: Such editing was necessary due to reasons such as transcription errors, speaker attribution mistakes, overconfident statements without evidence, missing key clinical details, and AI's lack of information about the patient context.

screen.reason: This is a qualitative interview study of 30 clinicians who used a commercial ambient AI documentation tool in routine outpatient care, evaluating how and why they edit AI-drafted notes.
